description: Simulates cancer biology, oncogenomics, TNM staging, Gompertzian tumor growth kinetics, RECIST 1.1 response evaluation, and virtual tumor board regimen stratification.

inputs.name: cancer_type
inputs.description: Primary cancer type (e.g., NSCLC, BREAST, COLORECTAL, MELANOMA)

inputs.name: tnm_raw
inputs.description: Anatomical T, N, M categories and site-specific biological modifiers

inputs.name: genomic_variants
inputs.description: List of somatic genomic variants with VAF and actionability tier

inputs.name: serial_lesions
inputs.description: Longitudinal target and non-target lesion measurements in mm

inputs.name: treatment_history
inputs.description: Historical cancer therapy regimens, lines, and prior nadirs

outputs.name: staging_result
outputs.description: AJCC 8th Edition stage group and risk classification

outputs.name: recist_assessment
outputs.description: RECIST 1.1 response classification, SLD delta, and nadir change

outputs.name: kinetic_projection
outputs.description: Gompertzian tumor volume trajectory under candidate therapies

outputs.name: stratified_regimens
outputs.description: Ranked multi-modality treatment regimens with evidence tier and predicted PFS

outputs.name: vtb_consensus
outputs.description: Multidisciplinary virtual tumor board consensus and monitoring plan

capabilities: AJCC 8th Edition TNM staging and prognostic grouping
Gompertzian tumor volume dynamics with Norton-Simon cell kill
Clonal subpopulation evolution and drug resistance modeling
Precision oncology genomic tiering and synthetic lethality scoring
Multidisciplinary virtual tumor board consensus generation
